answer_2.quote: Several coherence measures were evaluated. These were C_Umass, C_V, C_P, C_A and C_NPMI.

answer_4.quote: Four SMEs were recruited ... Their task was to provide a descriptive label for each T_ws and to use 'NA' if they were unable to provide a label. ... The SMEs were asked to rate on a scale of 1-3 how difficult it was to label each T_dc ...
answer_4.guideline: Provide descriptive labels for topic word-sets (T_ws) and rate difficulty of labeling topic document-collections (T_dc) on a scale of 1-3.
